title: Second derivative at a local minimum
statement: Let $f\colon\mathbb{R}\to\mathbb{R}$ and let $a,d,d_2\in\mathbb{R}$. If $f$ has a local minimum at $a$, its derivative at $a$ is $d$, and the derivative of $f'$ at $a$ is $d_2$, then $d_2\ge 0$.
